author: emy maloutas
text: Scott and his team were fantastic to work with! They were professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable throughout the entire process. They went above and beyond—not only installing our septic tank, but also grading our driveway and creating a new pad to relocate our propane tank farther from the house. Their attention to detail and willingness to help made a huge difference and truly helped turn our new house into our home. I highly recommend No Co Septic to anyone looking for honest, reliable, high-quality service.

author: Judy Litsey
text: We are so glad that we chose NoCo Septic to replace our tank and leach field. Scott and his crew were competent, skilled and thoughtful. They were eager to answer questions and explain the details to us.  It was a big job, but NoCo produced great results for us. We highly recommend them.

author: Kristin Nichols
text: I am so impressed and deeply grateful for the services and expertise of NoCo Septic.  When the alarm on our less than two year old septic system started going off, we had our tank pumped and immediately reached out to our installer.  After it became clear that he had ghosted us, we urgently started calling around for help.  We called many companies who were either unavailable, not responsive, or could not assist with our issue.  When I called NoCo Septic, not only was Aleesha kind and friendly, but it was clear within a few minutes of talking to her that she had a detailed knowledge of septic systems and the specific issue we were dealing with.  She walked me through their process for an onsite assessment and running diagnostics for our septic pump and control panel and provided me with a quote for parts and labor.  Despite having a pretty full calendar, Scott (the owner) came out the next day to handle the repairs for us.  He identified the problem in short order and even drove down to Denver to get a part for us so that he could get the septic system working for us before the weekend.  Scott took pride in his work and exhibited attention to detail and expertise I have not seen from any septic company we have worked with before.  Suffice it to say, he got our system up and running again and even took care of other minor details our installer had missed.  We were incredibly grateful to be able to take showers, clean our clothes, and run our dishwasher without worrying that we were going to fill our septic tank without a functioning pump.  And with most other companies unavailable until after the holiday, he quite literally saved our Thanksgiving.  Thank you so much!!!

author: Joan Dougherty
text: NoCo Septic was an excellent choice—very professional and did an awesome job. I would definitely recommend them.

author: Justin Walker
text: As a Realtor in the industry, finding amazing contractors for my clients is no easy feat. However, NOCO Septic has been nothing but professional, responsive and on time with a business acumen that I rarely see from other vendors. I am so thankful for NoCo Septic and the business they do for my clients. Thank you, Scott! You are one of a kind!
